method.name: Blanch the green beans
method.text: Trim 160 g green beans and boil for about 3–4 minutes until tender-crisp. Refresh in cold water and drain thoroughly.

method.name: Prepare the canned beans
method.text: Rinse and drain 160 g canned kidney beans and 160 g canned chickpeas separately.

method.name: Chop the vegetables
method.text: Finely dice 40 g red onion. Wash, dry and chop 12 g flat-leaf parsley.

method.name: Whisk the dressing
method.text: Whisk together 25 ml lemon juice, 20 ml olive oil, 5 g Dijon mustard and 1 g black pepper.

method.name: Combine and serve
method.text: Toss beans, onion and parsley with the dressing. Serve promptly, or refrigerate covered at 5°C or below and preferably eat the same day.
